gini_definition: G = sum_i sum_j |x_i - x_j| / (2 n^2 mu), x_i = monthly net_pnl per calendar month (zero-filled span), mu = mean(x) > 0 (if mu <= 0 report null). Relative mean absolute difference; 0 = perfectly diffuse, ->1 = maximally concentrated.
